source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 with Figs. 9.10 to 9.13 (PDF 198-200).

blocks.text: Jab electric field mein kisi area ka chhota tukra (element of area) rakhein to kuch lines of force us mein se guzarti hain (Fig. 9.10). Kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki number (ginti) ko us area se electric flux kehte hain. Ise Greek letter φₑ se likhte hain. Misal: Fig. 9.10 mein area A se flux 4 hai aur area B se 2.

blocks.alt: Magenta field lines oopar jati aur phailti hain. Neeche jahan qareeb hain, chhota peela area A 4 lines se guzarta hai. Oopar jahan door hain, barabar peela area B 2 lines se.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.10: E ke perpendicular (seedhi khadi) surface se electric flux (kitab ki Figure 9.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flux yani area se guzarne wali lines ki number: A se 4 aur B se 2. Dono area barabar hain, magar A par lines ghani hain, is liye wahan field zyada strong (taqatwar) hai.

Flux ko number ki shakal dene ke liye lines aise banayi jati hain ke field lines ke seedhe (perpendicular) rakhe unit area se guzarne wali lines ki number us point par field ki intensity E ke barabar ho.

Area ke tukre ko aam taur par vector area A se dikhate hain: is ki magnitude (miqdar) tukre ke area A ke barabar hoti hai aur direction (rukh) area ke normal (surface par seedhi khadi lakeer) ke saath hoti hai.
Fig. 9.11(a) mein area A field lines ke seedha (perpendicular) rakha hai, is liye EA lines us se guzarti hain. Yahan flux:
Fig. 9.11(b) mein area A field lines ke parallel (mutawazi) rakha hai; koi line is area ko paar nahi karti, is liye flux zero hai:

Fig. 9.11(c) mein A na seedha hai na parallel, balke field E se angle θ par jhuka hua hai. Yahan area ka woh projection (saya) lete hain jo field lines ke seedha ho. Is projection ka area A cosθ hai. Yahan flux:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in teen equations ko numbers (9.7), (9.8) aur (9.9) deti hai, magar yeh numbers is chapter mein pehle hi medium mein force, E = F/q aur F = qE ko mil chuke hain. Equations sahi hain, sirf numbers dobara istemal hue hain. Case (b) mein kitab "EA = 0" likhti hai; murad hai E·A = EA cos90° = 0.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse, magenta field teer E daen taraf. (a) Maximum: hara area field ke aar paar khara, vector A daen taraf E ke saath. (b) Minimum: area field ke parallel leta hua, A seedha oopar. (c) Area jhuka hua, A aur E ke darmiyan angle theta; saath peeli dashed patti A cos theta, yani E ke amudi us ka saya (projection).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.11: (a) zyada se zyada; (b) kam se kam; (c) (kitab ki Figure 9.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein saari lines area se guzarti hain: φ = EA (sab se zyada). (b) mein koi line nahi guzarti: φ = 0 (sab se kam). (c) mein sirf seedha projection A cosθ kaam karta hai: φ = EA cosθ.
Is tarah flat (chapte) tukre se electric flux E aur A ki madad se yeh hai:
Yahan θ field lines aur area ke normal ke darmiyan angle hai. Flux do vectors ka scalar product hai, is liye flux scalar quantity hai (is ki koi direction nahi). Is ki SI unit N m² C⁻¹ hai.
Charge ko gherne wali surface se electric flux

Ab radius r wale sphere (gola) ki closed (band) surface se flux nikalte hain, jab point charge q sphere ke centre (beech ka point) par ho (Fig. 9.12). φₑ = E·A sirf chapti surface par lagta hai, is liye sphere ki poori surface ko n chhote tukron mein baant dete hain jin ke area ΔA₁, ΔA₂, ΔA₃, …, ΔAₙ hain. Har vector area tukre se bahar ki taraf seedha hai. In tukron ke centre par fields E₁, E₂, E₃, …, Eₙ hain.

blocks.alt: Bara saya-daar sphere, centre par +q. Surface ke chhote tukre Delta A par siyah teer Delta A aur surkh teer E dono seedhe bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.12: centre par charge q ki wajah se sphere ki surface se kul flux q/ε0 hai (kitab ki Figure 9.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har tukre par E aur ΔA dono bahar ki taraf hain, is liye θ = 0 aur har tukre ka flux EΔA hai. Saare tukre jorne se E × 4πr² = q/ε₀ milta hai.
Eq. 9.10 ke mutabiq band surface se kul flux:
Har tukre par E aur vector area ki direction ek hai. Aur sab tukre charge se barabar faasle r par hain, is liye har jagah field ki magnitude barabar hai:
E vector area ke parallel hai, is liye θ = 0° aur har tukre ke liye:

blocks.latex: \phi_e = E\Delta A_1 + E\Delta A_2 + \dots + E\Delta A_n = E\,(\Delta A_1 + \Delta A_2 + \dots + \Delta A_n)
blocks.text_alt: φₑ = EΔA₁ + EΔA₂ + … + EΔAₙ = E (ΔA₁ + ΔA₂ + … + ΔAₙ)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dekhein: r cut gaya. Sphere bara ho ya chhota, flux q/ε₀ hi rehta hai. Bare sphere par field kamzor hai magar area utna hi zyada hai.

Ab sochein ke ek band surface S is sphere ko ghere hue hai. Fig. 9.13 mein dikhta hai ke jo lines sphere se nikalti hain wohi S se bhi nikalti hain, is liye S se flux wahi hai jo sphere se. Nateeja: band surface se kul flux us surface ki shakal par depend nahi karti; yeh sirf medium aur andar band charge par depend karti hai.

blocks.alt: Be-qaida gulabi band surface S ek halke hare sphere ko gherti hai jis ke centre par +q hai. Seedhi magenta lines +q se sphere aur S dono ke paar bahar jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.13 (kitab ki Figure 9.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo line sphere se nikalti hai wohi S se bhi nikalti hai, is liye S se flux bhi q/ε₀ hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 cm² area ki disc ek seedhi khadi (vertical) field E = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ mein rakhi hai aur us ki surface (satah) horizontal se 30° par hai. Disc se flux nikalein (numerical 9.6).
blocks.explanation: Disc ka normal vertical field se 30° banata hai, is liye φ = EA cos30° = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ × 10 × 10⁻⁴ m² × 0.866 = 433 N m² C⁻¹ (= 250√3 N m² C⁻¹).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Flux: area se guzarne wali field lines ki number; vector A normal ki direction mein.
Seedha area: φ = EA (sab se zyada); parallel: φ = 0; jhuka hua: φ = EA cosθ = E·A (9.10); scalar, unit N m² C⁻¹.
Sphere ke centre par charge q: φ = E × 4πr² = q/ε₀ (9.13); charge ko gherne wali kisi bhi band surface ke liye yehi flux; sirf medium aur andar ke charge par depend karta hai.
